questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
At which ground did Badgers record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 207, against Knights on 2023/11/26.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Best Batting Average' in the 14/15 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Mignon du Preez holds it with 69.17.

questions.question: How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Anneke Bosch) and #2 (Yolandi Potgieter) six-hitters (T20) in the 19/20 season?
questions.explanation: Anneke Bosch: 5 — Yolandi Potgieter: 4 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: Laura Wolvaardt became the first South African woman to reach 5,000 ODI runs. In how many innings did she reach the milestone, the second-fastest ever?
questions.explanation: Wolvaardt reached 5,000 ODI runs in 117 innings, second only to India's Smriti Mandhana (112 innings).

questions.question: At which ground did Khushi Mistry record their career-best bowling figures (4-26, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Rhinos on 2023/10/28.
